## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:
1. Java 1.7+
2. Maven/Gradle

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.swagger</groupId>
  <artifactId>swagger-java-client</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
compile "io.swagger:swagger-java-client:1.0.0"
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

* `target/swagger-java-client-1.0.0.jar`
* `target/lib/*.jar`

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following Java code:

```java
import gebo.microservices.api.client.heimdall.invoker.*;
import gebo.microservices.api.client.heimdall.invoker.auth.*;
import gebo.microservices.api.client.heimdall.model.*;
import gebo.microservices.api.client.heimdall.api.AuthControllerApi;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.*;

public class AuthControllerApiExample {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        
        AuthControllerApi apiInstance = new AuthControllerApi();
        LoginRequest body = new LoginRequest(); // LoginRequest | 
        try {
            OperationStatusAuthResponse result = apiInstance.authenticateUser(body);
            System.out.println(result);
        } catch (ApiException e) {
            System.err.println("Exception when calling AuthControllerApi#authenticateUser");
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
```
